actual_interfaces.name: DossierInput.model_validate_json
guarantees: rejects extra fields through the closed contract
rejects evaluator-only runtime sources
rejects synthetic sources in public cases
rejects sources newer than the evidence cutoff
rejects duplicate canonical patent documents
actual_interfaces.limitation: Python validation surface; no browser adapter is implemented here

actual_interfaces.name: run_dossier
guarantees: declared HT-B0a/HT-B0b/HT-B1/HT-B2/HT-B3 policy is recorded
events and manifest preserve bounded local resource counts
provider_calls and paid_cost_usd remain zero in this offline surface
actual_interfaces.limitation: not an HTTP job service; no live provider, cancellation, resume, or background progress endpoint

actual_interfaces.name: save_version
guarantees: uses exclusive file creation so one same-version writer wins
flushes and fsyncs the JSON payload
removes a partial destination after a write exception
actual_interfaces.limitation: local file history only; no server authorization, idempotency key, or multi-user merge

actual_interfaces.name: append_user_edits
guarantees: rejects a stale expected parent
creates a contiguous next dossier version
preserves prior user edits in the next version
actual_interfaces.limitation: the caller must preserve rejected text as base/theirs/yours recovery; conflicts are not automatically merged

actual_interfaces.name: source_view
guarantees: returns source ID/type/URI/revision/jurisdiction/date/hash
preserves the synthetic flag
returns an exact requested top-level structured field
actual_interfaces.limitation: the CLI viewer is not a general nested locator renderer and never fetches links

actual_interfaces.name: manage_dossier_history.py export
guarantees: writes selected-version dossier.json
writes English and Thai Markdown
keeps user_edits in JSON and a separate Markdown section
actual_interfaces.limitation: no PDF/DOCX export and no browser download adapter

result_shape.failure: { ok: false, code, outcome, retryable, preservedRefs, diagnosticId }

rules: keep DossierVersion, browser-local LocalSnapshot, and incomplete ProjectDraft as separate namespaces
return explicit unavailable or unknown outcomes instead of fake success
preserve source facts and user overlays separately
never dispatch a provider or fetch a source from the browser adapter

sanitized_fixture_hashes.use: positive import/history/export fixture only; never a public device or patent result

limitations: The three public cases are regulatory facts-only dossiers with empty patent inputs.
Unlisted device-patent pairs remain unjudged, never negatives.
This handoff does not establish clinical suitability, FTO, patent validity, investment merit, publication readiness, or production readiness.
Actual browser UI integration, accessibility, responsive behavior, and user validation are pending or not run.
